data.name: Adventure Craft
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Adventure Craft is a procedurally generated open-world PvE survival crafting action RPG where exploration, preparation and survival go hand in hand.

Explore a vast world, gather resources, hunt for food and loot, craft powerful equipment, build a place to call home and prepare yourself for the dangers that emerge as the world changes from day to night.

SURVIVE A CHANGING WORLD

The world of Adventure Craft becomes a very different place after dark. Explore and gather what you need during the day, then prepare for the monsters and other dangers that emerge at night.

EXPLORE A PROCEDURALLY GENERATED WORLD

Venture across a vast procedurally generated landscape filled with different biomes, wildlife, monsters, resources and hidden discoveries.

No two journeys through the world need to be the same.

CRAFT WEAPONS, ARMOUR AND EQUIPMENT

Collect materials and loot from throughout the world and use them to craft a wide variety of weapons, armour and other equipment.

Finding new resources opens up new possibilities and new ways to survive.

BUILD AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR HOME

Create a home in the wilderness and make it your own with furniture, decorations and other objects you discover or craft.

Your home gives you a place to prepare before heading back out into the world.

DESCEND INTO DANGEROUS CAVES

Explore deep underground cave systems filled with valuable treasure, rare resources and powerful creatures that hide from the world above.

The deeper you travel, the greater the danger — and the potential rewards.

FIGHT A WORLD FULL OF PvE THREATS

Battle wildlife, monsters and other hostile creatures using the weapons and equipment you create and discover.

Different enemies, environments and situations encourage you to change how you prepare, equip yourself and fight.

CREATE YOUR OWN PARTY

Use cloning technology to create custom party members and configure their behaviour using the AI Creator.

Build a group suited to the way you want to explore and survive.

TRAIN ANIMAL COMPANIONS

Raise and train an attack dog that grows stronger, gains experience and learns new abilities over time.

Take your companion with you as you explore, fight and survive the world of Adventure Craft.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 2 GB VRAM, Shader Model 4 capable
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 4 GB VRAM, DirectX 11 capable
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Adventure Craft contains stylized pixel-art violence and dark post-apocalyptic themes. Players can fight and kill hostile creatures, animals and human characters using melee weapons, firearms and other attacks. Combat can include red blood, bleeding effects, corpses and infected or monstrous enemies. The game also includes horror elements such as plague-infected creatures, demons and vampires. Violence is presented in a stylized pixel-art/comic aesthetic rather than realistically, and the game does not contain explicit sexual content or graphic gore.
